summary: Voters in Milak mostly raise broken village roads, the 2025 demolition of Bilaspur Road shops in the town, leopard fear and highway danger; the appreciation found is limited to benefits distributed at the 27 Sep 2026 Milak block camp, plus a foundation-stone event.

positives.english: We got Ayushman cards and Awas sanction letters at the camp
positives.hindi: शिविर में आयुष्मान कार्ड और आवास की मंजूरी मिली
positives.basis: At the Seva Sankalp camp in Milak block on 27 Sep 2026, five beneficiaries got Ayushman cards and five got CM Awas Yojana (Zero Poverty) sanction letters; 493 applications under various schemes were approved that day (Amar Ujala, 28 Sep 2026). Small numbers from one camp. Milak block membership in the AC is taken from the Wikipedia extent naming Milak tehsil (Milak MB).

positives.english: Five farmers got cheques under the farmers accident scheme, five lakh rupees in total
positives.hindi: किसान दुर्घटना योजना के पांच किसानों को चेक मिले
positives.basis: Five eligible beneficiaries received cheques totalling Rs 5 lakh under the CM Farmers' Accident Welfare Scheme at the same Milak block camp on 27 Sep 2026 (Amar Ujala, 28 Sep 2026). Only the total is stated, not each cheque.

positives.english: Disabled people got tricycles, crutches and hearing machines at the camp
positives.hindi: दिव्यांगों को ट्राइसाइकिल और बैसाखी मिली
positives.basis: Persons with disabilities received tricycles, crutches (baisakhi) and hearing machines at the same camp; numbers not stated (Amar Ujala, 28 Sep 2026).

positives.english: About 572 people got health mela benefits in the Seva Sankalp festival so far
positives.hindi: स्वास्थ्य मेले में अब तक करीब 572 लोगों को लाभ मिला
positives.basis: About 572 health mela beneficiaries so far in the seven-day Seva Sankalp festival in Milak block (Amar Ujala, 28 Sep 2026). A camp count, so a weak positive.

positives.english: Development works worth about Rs 1.80 crore got foundation stones in Milak
positives.hindi: मिलक में करीब 1.80 करोड़ के विकास कार्यों का शिलान्यास हुआ
positives.basis: Foundation stones for development works worth about Rs 1.80 crore laid in Milak block on 27 Sep 2026; individual works and completion not stated (Amar Ujala, 28 Sep 2026). Foundation stones are not a delivered benefit, so this is the weakest positive.

negatives.english: The main road to our village is full of potholes and mud
negatives.hindi: हमारे गांव की मुख्य सड़क गड्ढों और कीचड़ से भरी है
negatives.basis: Milak Bhure Khan village main road, dateline Swar (Samvad, 30 Aug 2026): potholes fill with rainwater and mud, the road is narrow so one vehicle is driven into the fields when two meet, and villagers say a delayed trip to hospital led to an elderly man's death. MLA Shafiq Ahmad Ansari said the road is in a proposal and construction starts after approval and fund release. District-level only: AC membership of Milak Bhure Khan is unconfirmed.

negatives.english: Our shops on Bilaspur Road were demolished without any other arrangement, it is alleged
negatives.hindi: बिलासपुर रोड की दुकानें बिना दूसरा इंतजाम किए तोड़ी गईं, आरोप है
negatives.basis: PWD demolished 23 shops on Bilaspur Road in Milak town (kasba) with JCB machines on 20 Jan 2025, after a one-day notice. Shopkeepers allege no alternative arrangement was made; the administration said it acted under a government order (Amar Ujala, 20 Jan 2025). AC-specific: Milak town is Milak MB, named in the Wikipedia extent. Dated 2025.

negatives.english: There is fear of a leopard in Milak Kazi, people want a cage installed
negatives.hindi: मिलक काजी में तेंदुए का डर है, पिंजरा लगाने की मांग है
negatives.basis: Dateline Swar (Amar Ujala, 25 Jun 2026): a dog was found mauled in a sugarcane field in Milak Kazi and villagers believe a leopard killed it; they asked the forest department to patrol and set up a cage. District-level only: AC membership of Milak Kazi is unconfirmed.

negatives.english: It is alleged that a tempo driver was beaten after asking for a parked Bolero to be moved
negatives.hindi: आरोप है कि गाड़ी हटाने को कहने पर टेंपो चालक की पिटाई हुई
negatives.basis: In Kyorar village near Milak, a tempo driver asked for a Bolero blocking the village road to be moved on 1 Sep 2026 and was allegedly beaten with sticks; police registered a case on his complaint (Amar Ujala, 5 Sep 2026). Kyorar AC membership unconfirmed; district-level only.

negatives.english: Buses collided on the highway near Milak and three people died
negatives.hindi: मिलक के पास हाईवे पर बसें टकराईं, तीन लोगों की मौत
negatives.basis: Two buses collided near the Bhairav Baba shrine on the Lucknow-Delhi highway in the Milak area at about 4 AM on 22 Jul 2024; at least three killed including the driver, 49 injured; cause not stated (Daily Jagran, 22 Jul 2024). Dated 2024 and a one-off. AC-specific only by the place name Milak; the highway stretch inside Milak MB is not confirmed.

notes: Identity: Wikipedia confirms constituency 38, Milak, SC, district Rampur. The extent line names Shahabad tehsil and lists Milak MB (Milak tehsil) and Milak KC villages, so Milak town is inside the AC. Round 2 searches (about 10 more, Hindi and English) on Milak water supply, drains, CHC/hospital, sugarcane dues, and completed road or bridge projects in 2024-2026 returned nothing sourced for Milak. The only drain report found (Surajpur, Patwai area, 28 Mar 2026) is not in Milak. Still unmet: the brief asks for at least 3 AC-specific negatives, and only 2 are confirmed (Milak town shops, Milak town highway crash by place name). Bhure Khan road, Milak Kazi leopard, and Kyorar tempo assault are district-level or unconfirmed. Positives are all from one 27 Sep 2026 Milak block camp article, so the delivered-benefit evidence is thin and camp-based; the 102-project CM announcement was dropped. Field check needed: Milak town water supply and drains, Milak CHC services, Bhure Khan and other village roads and their AC membership, Bilaspur Road shopkeepers' current status, leopard status at Milak Kazi, Bhairav Baba highway crossing safety, and sugarcane dues at the local mill.

round2.changes: Re-fetched all sources. Corrected P2 (Rs 5 lakh was the total for five people, not one cheque) and the scheme name to the article's wording. Removed the India Daily 102-projects claim as a positive: the article says the event 'will be' held and states no completed projects. Replaced P3 (information camp) with the disability aids and P4 with the 572 health mela beneficiaries from the same article. Re-ranked positives: Ayushman/Awas, farmers cheques, disability aids, health mela, foundation stones. Negatives: fixed the Bhure Khan dateline and AC status (district-level), removed the unsupported claim that Bhure Khan is outside the Wikipedia extent, and re-ranked by impact: road, shops, leopard, tempo assault, bus crash. Added the Wikipedia identity check. Surajpur drain waterlogging (Amar Ujala, 28 Mar 2026) was checked and is in Patwai area, not Milak, so it was not used.
